title: kith-attach: write_blob_streaming max_bytes not bounded by MAX_BLOB_BYTES
description: write_blob enforces MAX_BLOB_BYTES (200 MiB) as a hard check before any I/O. write_blob_streaming accepts a caller-supplied max_bytes parameter and enforces only that — nothing checks max_bytes <= MAX_BLOB_BYTES. Any call site that passes max_bytes > 200 MiB or u64::MAX silently bypasses the hard limit. The two write paths have inconsistent effective limits. Fix: at the top of write_blob_streaming, before any I/O, return an error if max_bytes > MAX_BLOB_BYTES.
